software.name: cpm2203
software.notes: Single density, the format the H-37 boots from unaided. The disks name themselves "for H-37 Controller SSSD"; the sectors are 256 bytes, ten to a track over 40 tracks of one side, laid down with a 3:1 interleave. The BIOS holds no H-17 driver, so on a Z-90 the H-88-1 sitting alongside the Z-89-37 cannot be reached: the system signs on "FOR H37 DISKS", and CONFIGUR's hardware verification counts three H/Z37 minifloppy drives and no H/Z17 ones even with a hard-sectored disk loaded. Using both controllers from one system would need a BIOS rebuilt to carry both drivers.

software.name: cpm2204
software.notes: The H-37 build, signing on "FOR H37 DISKS WITH OPTION(S) IE3" and dated 09/15/82; the hard-sectored H-17 build of the same version is on the h17_flop list. Disk 2 adds BSYSGEN over 2.2.03 and carries the MOVCPM relocators, disk 3 the BIOS source. The setup disk holds SETUP.COM and its SET*.OVR overlays, and boots into Setup rather than into CP/M. As with 2.2.03 the BIOS has no H-17 driver, so a Z-90's H-88-1 is out of reach; CONFIGUR reports three H/Z37 minifloppy drives and no H/Z17 ones.
